reviews.text: Pools123 DFW installed our pool in august.What a wonderful job. Everything was so professional, Preston was very helpful throughout the entire process, he kept us well informed and also whenever we had any questions before during and after the install he responded promptly and efficiently. I would highly recommend pools123 and Preston. Thank you so much for an awesome pool and experience!

Preston was so patient,  answered all our questions and helps us find the right pool for us! The  process was painless and we had everything up and running in 3 weeks! We are super happy with our new pool! We highly recommend them

Pools 123 dfw installed our 35ft pool with spa. Joey our sales and go to guy was very professional and helpful. Aside from a glitch with the handrail and a little communication issue with the scheduler all went well. Pool looks great. Would recommend to anyone looking for a fiberglass pool.

We absolutely love our pool. Blake and his team were amazing to work with throughout the entire process. He made everything go so smooth from start to finish, including when we wanted to change things in the middle of the project. They truly care about meeting your needs and giving you the dream backyard you’ve always wanted. I highly recommend Pools123 and using Blake and his team to take care of all of your needs.
